scenario_name: Straightforward order status inquiry with follow-up on details
judge_summary: This conversation is a clean, high-quality interaction: the assistant accurately retrieved and communicated the watch delivery details and confirmed scope when asked. It maintained context correctly and used a clear, polite tone, with no evident misunderstandings or repair needs.

bot: Hello! What can I assist you with today?

transcript.user: Hi, when is my Galaxy Watch arriving?
bot: Let me check the latest status of your Galaxy Watch order.

Your **Samsung Galaxy Watch 7** order (**ORD-20260628-001**) is still **being prepared for shipment** at the distribution center. The **estimated delivery is July 3–5, 2026**; tracking isn’t available yet and will be assigned once it ships.

transcript.user: Thanks, is that for the Galaxy Watch 7 only, right? I don’t really care about the other items.
bot: Yes—those dates and the “being prepared for shipment” status are for the **Samsung Galaxy Watch 7** on order **ORD-20260628-001** only.

transcript.user: Okay, perfect, thanks—that’s all I needed.
bot: Can I help with anything else?
